title: SMARTctl Exporter

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: Physical disks reporting SMART, after the node005 megaraid duplicates are excluded at the exporter.

targets.expr: count(smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"})

panels.title: SMART failed
panels.description: Drive's own overall SMART verdict is FAILED. Note PASSED means little: ZJV4M3HE passed while faulted.

targets.expr: count((min by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_smart_status{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) == 0) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Reallocated > 0
panels.description: Disks that have remapped at least one sector. Growth over time is the signal; see Error trends.

targets.expr: count((max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"Reallocated_Sector_Ct", attribute_value_type="raw"}) > 0) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pending sectors
panels.description: Disks with sectors waiting to be reallocated: unreadable right now.

targets.expr: count((max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"Current_Pending_Sector", attribute_value_type="raw"}) > 0) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}) or vector(0)

count(((max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"Reported_Uncorrect|Uncorrectable_Error_Cnt", attribute_value_type="raw"}) > 0) or (max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"Offline_Uncorrectable", attribute_value_type="raw"}) > 0)) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: CRC errors
panels.description: Interface CRC errors: cable, backplane or HBA, not the platters.

targets.expr: count((max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"UDMA_CRC_Error_Count|CRC_Error_Count", attribute_value_type="raw"}) > 0) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Hidden prior use
panels.description: Seagate disks whose FARM power-on hours exceed SMART by more than 1000: SMART was reset before sale.

targets.expr: count(((max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600 - on (instance, device) (max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600)) > 1000) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}) or vector(0)

max(max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_temperature{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", temperature_type="current"}) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"})

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: One row per physical disk. FARM columns are Seagate only (farm-metrics.sh, every 15m). Hours before reset = FARM minus SMART: runtime hidden by a SMART reset before sale.

targets.expr: max by (instance, device, model_name, serial_number, firmware_version, interface) (smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"})

max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_temperature{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", temperature_type="current"}) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600 and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600 and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

(max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600 - on (instance, device) (max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600)) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_cycle_count{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"Reallocated_Sector_Ct", attribute_value_type="raw"}) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"Current_Pending_Sector", attribute_value_type="raw"}) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"Reported_Uncorrect|Uncorrectable_Error_Cnt", attribute_value_type="raw"}) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"Offline_Uncorrectable", attribute_value_type="raw"}) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"UDMA_CRC_Error_Count|CRC_Error_Count", attribute_value_type="raw"}) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

min by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_smart_status{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_capacity_bytes{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}

panels.title: Reallocated sectors
panels.description: SMART 5. Any growth means the disk is consuming spare sectors.

targets.expr: max by (instance, device, serial_number) (max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"Reallocated_Sector_Ct", attribute_value_type="raw"}) * on (instance, device) group_left (serial_number, model_name) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"})

panels.title: Pending sectors
panels.description: SMART 197. Sectors that failed a read and await rewrite or reallocation.

targets.expr: max by (instance, device, serial_number) (max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"Current_Pending_Sector", attribute_value_type="raw"}) * on (instance, device) group_left (serial_number, model_name) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"})

max by (instance, device, serial_number) (max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"Reported_Uncorrect|Uncorrectable_Error_Cnt", attribute_value_type="raw"}) * on (instance, device) group_left (serial_number, model_name) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"})

panels.title: Interface CRC errors
panels.description: SMART 199. Rising here with clean media counters points at cabling or the backplane.

targets.expr: max by (instance, device, serial_number) (max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name=~"UDMA_CRC_Error_Count|CRC_Error_Count", attribute_value_type="raw"}) * on (instance, device) group_left (serial_number, model_name) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"})

max by (instance, device, serial_number) (max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_temperature{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", temperature_type="current"}) * on (instance, device) group_left (serial_number, model_name) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"})

panels.title: Data written rate
panels.description: SMART 241 x 512 bytes for SATA, bytes_written for NVMe.

targets.expr: max by (instance, device, serial_number) ((rate(smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name="Total_LBAs_Written", attribute_value_type="raw"}[$__rate_interval]) * 512 or rate(smartctl_device_bytes_written{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (instance, device) group_left (serial_number, model_name) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"})

panels.title: FARM vs SMART
panels.description: Seagate's FARM log is not cleared when SMART is reset, so it shows a drive's real age. Hours before reset = FARM minus SMART power-on hours.

targets.expr: max by (instance, device, serial_number) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", serial_number=~"$serial_number"}) / 3600

max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600 and on (instance, device) max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600

(max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600 - on (instance, device) (max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600))
max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_cycles{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"})

max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_cycle_count{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) and on (instance, device) max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600
max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_reallocated_sectors{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"})
max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_unrecoverable_read_errors{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"})

panels.title: Power-on hours: FARM vs SMART
panels.description: The gap between the bars is runtime the drive had before its SMART counters were reset.

targets.expr: label_join(max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600, "disk", " ", "instance", "device")

label_join((max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600 and on (instance, device) max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) / 3600), "disk", " ", "instance", "device")

sort_desc(100 - smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name="Wear_Leveling_Count",attribute_value_type="value"} * on(instance, device) group_left(interface,serial_number,model_family,model_name) smartctl_device{interface=~"sat",serial_number=~"$serial_number",model_name=~"$device_model"})

sort_desc(smartctl_device_percentage_used{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"} * on(instance, device) group_left(interface,serial_number,model_family,model_name) smartctl_device{interface=~"nvme",serial_number=~"$serial_number",model_name=~"$device_model"})

smartctl_device_media_errors{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"} * on(instance, device) group_left(interface,serial_number,model_family,model_name) smartctl_device{interface=~"$type",serial_number=~"$serial_number",model_name=~"$device_model"} > 0

smartctl_device_critical_warning{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"} * on(instance, device) group_left(interface,serial_number,model_family,model_name) smartctl_device{interface=~"$type",serial_number=~"$serial_number",model_name=~"$device_model"} > 0

max(smartctl_device_bytes_written{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"} * on(instance, device) group_left(interface,serial_number,model_family,model_name) smartctl_device{interface=~"$type",serial_number=~"$serial_number",model_name=~"$device_model"}) by (device, instance, model_name, serial_number)

max((smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", attribute_name="Total_LBAs_Written", attribute_value_type="raw"} * on (instance,device) smartctl_device_block_size{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk",blocks_type="physical"}) * on(instance, device) group_left(interface,serial_number,model_family,model_name) smartctl_device{interface=~"$type",serial_number=~"$serial_number",model_name=~"$device_model"}) by (device, instance, model_name, serial_number)

panels.title: Collection status
panels.description: smartctl exit status is a bitmask: bit 6 (64) = errors in the device error log, bit 7 (128) = self-test errors. FARM log read = 0 on a Seagate disk that used to report FARM means the read is failing; 143 = killed by the 60s timeout.

targets.expr: max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_smartctl_exit_status{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"}) and on (instance, device) smartctl_device{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk", interface=~"$type", serial_number=~"$serial_number", model_name=~"$device_model"}
max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_log_present{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"})
max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_smartctl_exit_code{instance=~"$node", device=~"$disk"})

description: Per-disk SMART health plus Seagate FARM lifetime. Managed in git: files/grafana-compose/dashboards/SMARTctl_Disk_Health.json; edits in the UI are overwritten.
